How far an electric cargo tricycle gets: Yadda keken kaya mai ƙafa uku na lantarki zai je ya dawo da cajin batir ɗaya, a kan tuddai yana fifita hanyoyin keke, da abin da yake tanadi idan aka kwatanta da mota (saye, mai, haraji, inshora, ajiye mota, gyara), a cikin shafinsa na musamman.
Round trip from a start point to a desti: Tafiyar zuwa da dawowa daga wurin farawa zuwa inda za a je a kan titunan da keke zai iya bi (yana fifita hanyoyin keke) tare da batir da aka yi amfani da shi a kan ƙasa, da taswirar nisa ta yadda keken zai je ya dawo ta kowace hanya.
Yearly cost of the cargo bike against a: Kuɗin shekara na keken kaya idan aka kwatanta da mota don tafiye-tafiye iri ɗaya: saye, makamashi, haraji, inshora, ajiye mota da gyara, a kuɗin ƙasar wurin farawa.
